messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(18 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Problematic, see inline comments. The kernel collection path sleeps under the obd_devs spinlock and leaks memory on several paths, and the userspace/YAML output looks wrong once more than one changelog user is registered. There is no test either: lctl only takes the Netlink path when getuid() != 0, so the root-run test suites never reach this code. Could a sanity case register two or more changelog users (one with a mask), then compare `lctl get_param mdd.*.changelog_users` run as $RUNAS against the debugfs output?

commit.subject: LU-19768 mdd: add Netlink support for changelog_users
commit.message:
LU-19768 mdd: add Netlink support for changelog_users

The information in changelog_users is located in debugfs which
might not be available. We can use the YAML Netlink API to
provide this information. Implement changelog_users and wire
it in liblustreapi so the traditonal tools continue to work.

Signed-off-by: James Simmons <jsimmons@infradead.org>
Signed-off-by: Timothy Day <timday@thelustrecollective.com>
